# Collaboration guidelines

- Collaborators with write access may edit any part of the project, push
  changes, manage issues, and merge pull requests without the original
  author's approval. Other contributors may submit pull requests from forks.
- Describe significant changes, run relevant checks, and update affected
  documentation. Follow the [contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- Preserve copyright notices, applicable licenses, third-party attribution,
  and the actual authorship of contributions.
- Keep scientific evidence tied to its software version, inputs, and
  calculation records. Identify new results and corrections separately from
  previously recorded results.
- Identify each release's publisher, source commit, changes, and checks.
  Attribute the original work without implying endorsement of later changes.
  Follow the [publication guide](../Docs/Release/PUBLISHING.md).
